name: What lighting works best over an ADU kitchen counter?

mainEntity.name: How should task lighting be planned in a compact ADU kitchen?
mainEntity.text: How should task lighting be planned in a compact ADU kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good lighting can make a small ADU kitchen feel safer, larger, and more expensive. Under-cabinet lighting is often the most useful because it puts light exactly where food prep happens and reduces shadows from overhead fixtures. Recessed ceiling lights can provide general room illumination, but they should not be the only light source in a compact kitchen. Pendant lights may work if there is an island or peninsula, but many ADU kitchens do better with simple, clean ceiling lighting that does not crowd the space. The lighting plan should also consider color temperature so the room feels bright without looking harsh. In a small ADU, thoughtful lighting can improve the entire experience of using the kitchen and make finishes look much better. It also helps photos and rental marketing if the unit will be shown online. The best ADU kitchen lighting is practical first and decorative second.
acceptedAnswer.description: Under-cabinet lighting is often the most effective task lighting for an ADU kitchen because it brightens counters without taking up space. Ceiling lights should support the overall room, but the work surface needs focused light for prep, cooking, and cleanup.
